diagnosis: The large output is not a repeated complete locked-plan JSON. Common job rows retain plan/source hashes, their own budget/prediction and original bindings.

Generic child raws recursively retain the original dataset, market raw_chunks with fine normals, caches, full quote-risk/chunk risk records, and policy base/refined evidence. quote_risk stores the same full risk under value and chunked_worker; paired stores risk sources and extracted risks; bump deep-copies full base risk into three variants and retains one again as value. This keeps original finance evidence but multiplies its physical representation.
_encode_tree gives a fresh array ID to each array occurrence, with no alias/content reference memo. Generic outputs are literal; only root kind teacher uses the special recipe and compress=True.

Many small array occurrences cause large tree/descriptor JSON and 4096-member packs. The observed bump root metadata is 549.5MB and position root metadata is 566.5MB, so NPZ-only reductions do not remove that overhead.

ZIP member expanded and stored bytes match in the inspected generic packs. Large original normals and fixed-width Unicode reason/status arrays are physically written again; matching shapes are not used to claim matching values.

immutable_io_contract.hardlink_implication: A same-filesystem, exact-byte replacement of only a closed arrays.npz preserves pathname and existing receipts/byte guards. It does not provide financial approval or skip saved checks.
immutable_io_contract.limits: Immutability is the current writer contract, not an OS read-only permission. Any future in-place mutation of a linked target would affect all links; only independently byte-confirmed closed files can be candidates.
immutable_io_contract.memo: Physical guard seals relative file/directory inventory and file byte SHA; it does not bind inode, link count, mtime or ctime. Source/raw/financial inputs and original replay remain required.
immutable_io_contract.reader: Saved reader authenticates exact metadata/NPZ bytes plus shape/dtype/expanded byte limit. Numeric saved finance checks remain separate.
immutable_io_contract.writer: write_artifact rejects an existing directory and uses xb to create metadata, NPZ, then receipt; no in-place rewrite in this path. Pilot writer splits into new immutable pack directories. A complete pack receipt is distinct from whole job/phase completion.

minimal_candidates.added_work: Bounded exact-byte/closed-file confirmation and an authorized reversible physical operation; no finance rerun or source revision is intrinsically required.
minimal_candidates.limitations: No actual deduplication or full binary equality check was performed. Observed two-pair candidates do not establish enough capacity for all 3138 jobs. No metadata reduction; no cross-volume sharing. C/F/WSL and CAS restore copies need separate space accounting.
minimal_candidates.method_if_separately_authorized: Select candidates by existing receipt SHA and size; confirm current exact bytes and closed writer state before replacement, create a temporary hardlink on the same st_dev, then atomically replace only the duplicate pathname. Keep receipt/metadata unchanged. A fresh detached copy plus atomic replacement reverses the physical sharing without changing bytes.
